1: import * as fs from 'fs';
2: import * as path from 'path';
3: import { loadPlugins } from './config';
4: import { parseFrontmatter } from './frontmatter';
5: import { PluginPipeline, type Plugin, type SsgContext } from './plugin';
6: import type { SiteConfig } from './template';
7: import type { Page } from './types';
8: 
9: export interface BuildOptions {
10:   contentDir: string;
11:   outputDir: string;
12:   siteTitle?: string;
13:   templatesDir?: string;
14:   defaultTemplate?: string;
15:   defaultLayout?: string;
16:   configPath?: string;
17: }
18: 
19: export const DEFAULT_CONTENT_DIR = './content';
20: export const DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR = './dist';
21: export const DEFAULT_TEMPLATES_DIR = './templates';
22: export const DEFAULT_SITE_TITLE = 'My Static Site';
23: 
24: const MARKDOWN_EXTENSION = /\.(md|markdown)$/i;
25: 
26: export function collectMarkdownFiles(contentDir: string): string[] {
27:   if (!fs.existsSync(contentDir)) return [];
28: 
29:   const files: string[] = [];
30:   const walk = (dir: string): void => {
31:     for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
32:       const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
33:       if (entry.isDirectory()) {
34:         walk(full);
35:       } else if (entry.isFile() && MARKDOWN_EXTENSION.test(entry.name)) {
36:         files.push(full);
37:       }
38:     }
39:   };
40:   walk(contentDir);
41:   return files.sort();
42: }
43: 
44: export function slugFor(filePath: string, contentDir: string): string {
45:   const relative = path.relative(contentDir, filePath).replace(/\\/g, '/');
46:   return relative.replace(MARKDOWN_EXTENSION, '');
47: }
48: 
49: function toSiteConfig(options: BuildOptions): SiteConfig {
50:   return {
51:     title: options.siteTitle ?? DEFAULT_SITE_TITLE,
52:     templatesDir: options.templatesDir ? path.resolve(options.templatesDir) : path.resolve(DEFAULT_TEMPLATES_DIR),
53:     defaultTemplate: options.defaultTemplate,
54:     defaultLayout: options.defaultLayout,
55:   };
56: }
57: 
58: function createContext(options: BuildOptions): SsgContext {
59:   return {
60:     contentDir: path.resolve(options.contentDir),
61:     outputDir: path.resolve(options.outputDir),
62:     siteConfig: toSiteConfig(options),
63:     pages: [],
64:     options: { ...options },
65:   };
66: }
67: 
68: export class Ssg {
69:   private readonly pipeline: PluginPipeline;
70: 
71:   constructor(plugins: Plugin[]) {
72:     this.pipeline = new PluginPipeline(plugins);
73:   }
74: 
75:   static async create(options: { plugins?: Plugin[]; configPath?: string } = {}): Promise<Ssg> {
76:     const plugins = options.plugins ?? (await loadPlugins(options.configPath));
77:     return new Ssg(plugins);
78:   }
79: 
80:   getPlugins(): Plugin[] {
81:     return this.pipeline.getPlugins();
82:   }
83: 
84:   build(options: BuildOptions): Promise<Page[]> {
85:     return this.run(options, true);
86:   }
87: 
88:   rebuild(options: BuildOptions): Promise<Page[]> {
89:     return this.run(options, false);
90:   }
91: 
92:   private async run(options: BuildOptions, runStart: boolean): Promise<Page[]> {
93:     const context = createContext(options);
94: 
95:     if (runStart) {
96:       await this.pipeline.onStart(context);
97:     }
98:     await this.pipeline.beforeBuild(context);
99: 
100:     for (const file of collectMarkdownFiles(context.contentDir)) {
101:       const source = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
102:       const { data, content } = parseFrontmatter(source);
103:       const slug = slugFor(file, context.contentDir);
104:       const page: Page = {
105:         slug,
106:         link: `${slug}.html`,
107:         outputPath: path.join(context.outputDir, `${slug}.html`),
108:         filePath: file,
109:         data,
110:         content,
111:         html: '',
112:         template: data.template,
113:         layout: data.layout,
114:       };
115:       context.pages.push(page);
116:       await this.pipeline.onFile(page, context);
117:     }
118: 
119:     fs.mkdirSync(context.outputDir, { recursive: true });
120:     await this.pipeline.afterBuild(context);
121:     await this.pipeline.onEnd(context);
122: 
123:     return context.pages;
124:   }
125: }

128:   const engine = await Ssg.create({ configPath: options.configPath });
129:   return engine.build(options);

part.text:
Implemented incremental builds and caching.

**What was added:**
- `src/cache.ts` — SHA-256 hash utils, `.ssg-cache.json` manifest read/write (stores rendered HTML + parsed frontmatter per page), and precise template dependency tracking (named template + layout + partials).
- `src/ssg.ts` — `Ssg.buildDetailed`/`BuildResult` with stats; incremental skip logic (source hash + template deps), clean builds, stale-output removal, and cache write on every build. `buildSite`/`rebuild` signatures unchanged.
- `src/cli.ts` — `--incremental` and `--clean` flags; reports `pages built / skipped / ms saved`.
- `tests/incremental.test.ts` + CLI flag tests (17 new tests).

**Key design points:**
- Skip decision = source hash matches **and** all recorded template/layout/partial file hashes match, so changing one page's template only rebuilds that page.
- Cache invalidation covers missing cache, `--clean`, site-config changes (title/templates dir), source changes, and template additions/removals.
- Fixed a subtlety: the manifest caches the fully-rendered output file (not just `page.html`) so skipped pages reproduce byte-identical output.
- Plugin architecture untouched — unchanged pages simply bypass the `onFile` pipeline; dev-server rebuilds are now incremental too.

Verified: `tsc` compiles clean, CLI works end-to-end (e.g. `2 skipped`, `1 skipped, 14ms saved`).
